title: Published AlphaGenome example: four variants in T-cells
notebook_execution_timestamp_scope: Timestamp embedded in upstream notebook cell metadata; not an independently verified publication or model-release date.
normalization: Parsed only the upstream createDataTable data literal without executing JavaScript. Unwrapped v fields, ignored display-format f strings, converted upstream NaN to JSON null. Preserved full numeric precision. Ontology CURIE is supplied in this metadata from the upstream cell filter; it is not inserted into source rows.

score_semantics.raw_score: Modality/scorer-specific predicted molecular effect; preserve the variant_scorer field for meaning and aggregation.
score_semantics.quantile_score: Signed empirical relative score from the published model output; not AVI PHRED and not a probability of disease.
score_semantics.absent_modality: A modality absent from this tissue subset has no supplied measurement here; absence must not be filled with zero.

limitations: Published notebook snapshot, not a fresh query or inference result.
Four explicitly named example variants only; no DNM1 values.
T-cells only; no evidence for unsupplied tissues.
No full reference/alternate genomic track arrays; only summarized variant-effect scores.
Model and annotation versions are not recorded in the upstream example.

licensing.documentation_license: CC BY 4.0 according to the official repository README.
licensing.output_use: Model outputs are subject to AlphaGenome terms. Treat this as noncommercial research example output; do not apply permissive AVI static-download licensing to these scores.
licensing.attribution: Source: Google DeepMind, AlphaGenome batch variant scoring notebook; original numerical notebook outputs extracted without running AlphaGenome.

normalization_notes: Modality retains original output_type. RNA_SEQ contains 486 gene-expression rows and 2 polyadenylation rows; separate by scorer.
Unit descriptions come from the current official scorer documentation; the historical notebook model implementation/version was not separately archived.
signed describes the scoring method, not an inferred biological effect.
